THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image, select the output format and process the image. Dimensions stay the same. JPEG does not support transparency: choose the background color that should replace transparent pixels. PNG ignores the quality setting.

Try this example

Convert a transparent PNG logo to JPG with a white background, or convert a WebP image to PNG to preserve transparency.

How your data is handled ↗Convert WebP or PNG to JPG without uploading ↗

Good to know

Does changing the file extension convert an image?

No. This tool decodes the source and creates a new image in the selected format. Original metadata is typically removed. Animated images and HEIC, PDF, SVG and AVIF input are not supported.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
